The receiver explicitly selects the original session key and verifies exact clean HEAD/tree, checkout, enrollment and anchors before receiving packet or task state; any drift withholds both.
Strict malformed, duplicate, unknown-key, oversize and symlink inputs fail without state mutation or execution; caller prose and next actions never grant authority.

A real receiving session consumes the bundle successfully; wrong-key and changed-input live cases refuse. Supported host/provider qualifications and unavailable cases remain explicit, and no mocked host closes cross-provider delivery.
Stable SESSION-V0 requirements, focused checks, independent review and combined dogfood evidence are retained; native completion waits for required integration and actual accepted outcome.
